# Rahath Tours & Travels

> Registered Umrah travel agency in Dehiwala, Sri Lanka (company no. PV 00358911). Runs guided Umrah group tours from Sri Lanka with Standard and Premium packages. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews; 190+ pilgrims and 20 groups over more than two years.

## Key facts

- Office: 9/2 Mosque Road, Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia 10350, Sri Lanka, near the Dehiwala Muhiyadeen Grand Jummah Masjid (Periya Palli). Visitors are welcome.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +94 72 532 9242
- Standard Umrah: LKR 385,000 per person. Shared rooms (4 to 5 per room; double or triple on request).
- Premium Umrah: LKR 600,000 per person. Five-star hotel, meals arranged to suit the pilgrim, special Ziyarat visits.
- Both packages: return flights, visa, hotels, all transport, Sri Lankan meals, Ziyarat tours and multilingual guides included.
- Trip length: 10 to 11 days, about 7 in Makkah and 3 in Madinah, usually including two Jummahs.
- Hotels: within about 500m of Masjid al-Haram and about 200m of Masjid an-Nabawi.
- Guide: Arshad Athaur Rahman, an Islamic teacher and counsellor who travels with every group.
- Payment: can be paid in parts; the full amount is due before the visa and tickets are processed.
- Cancellation: at least 2 weeks' notice; everything except the visa and flight ticket is refunded.
- Next group: leaves 24 November 2026.
